page.notes: The Syriac and Arabic-script lines at the foot (after the Greek of 2 Tim. 1:9-10) could not be read letter by letter, so they are marked illegible. The line-initial Syriac word in the Jeremiah gloss is also illegible. The Greek of 2 Tim. 1:9 and Acts 13:2 is transcribed from a low-resolution scan and may contain small errors. The italic/roman split in the Latin translation of 2 Tim. 1:9-10 is uncertain. The Hebrew of Mal. 1:2-3 and Jer. 6:30 is copied without vowel points, as printed. The "B 2" signature is at the bottom centre. Faint show-through text at the lower left and right is ignored.
